# Which roles answer a pad, a gap and a column?

Read this when your style plugin answers the padding of a control, a surface or a row, a gap, a gutter or the width of a column.

**In [`spacing.json`](../../../../../contracts/design/spacing.json)** for these:

| Roles | Scale |
|---|---|
| `pad-*`, `gap-*`, `gutter` | `sp` |

**Two roles read no scale at all**, and a literal is the only answer for them: `container-max` and `aspect-media`.

<!-- @tree GENERATED by bun run generate:token-tree. Edit that script, not this copy. -->

| role | type | user scale | default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--aspect-media` | number | none | none |
| `--container-max` | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--fit-media` | keyword | none | none |
| `--gap-actions` | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--gap-control` | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--gap-inline` | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--gap-items` | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--gap-row` | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--gutter` | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--pad-control-text-y` | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--pad-control-x` | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--pad-control-y` | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--pad-row-indent` | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--pad-row-x` | dimension | fixed | none |
